tasks.title: Build a provenance-aware graph projection and query API
tasks.description:
Outcome: A provenance-aware queryable graph over canonical planner and derived code relationships.

Current implementation: Tasks have textual goals/dependencies but no common reverse source/rationale traversal; a derived graph must not become a second source of truth.

Implementation responsibility:
- Build graph projections from canonical requirement/decision/task/dependency entities and revision-bound source/index evidence.
- Define typed work-order, ownership, code-usage and rationale/applicability edges; keep scheduling dependencies distinct from shared source links.
- Record source/provider/version/configuration, confidence and stale/review states for extracted or inferred relationships.
- Expose bounded query/path/impact APIs and incremental refresh from DB events; require explicit canonical operations to promote proposals.
- Use existing SQL/domain/index boundaries; no mandatory graph database or embedding service.

Acceptance and evidence:
- A query can traverse requirement -> decision -> implementation -> test evidence and back without fabricating missing edges.
- Current and historical graph views remain source/revision scoped.
- Derived index rebuild cannot rewrite canonical planner meaning.

tasks.title: Refresh impacted context and manage review evidence over time
tasks.description:
Outcome: Incremental freshness and explicit review obligations after source or planner changes.

Current implementation: Location resolution, context delivery, semantic conformity and historical tests have different validity conditions.

Implementation responsibility:
- Consume durable command/source impact events and refresh only affected graph/index/context/read evidence.
- Track workspace/source/configuration and entity context revisions; invalidate review/test availability after real relevant changes.
- Keep version-bound reviewed-unchanged or pending review states for descriptions/decisions and reject stale reconciliation.
- Bound large fan-out with pagination/cursors and make no-op/cached behavior measurable; preserve current versus historical evidence separately.

Acceptance and evidence:
- Unrelated changes do not force a full prompt/index rebuild.
- Relocated code can be found while its architectural rationale is still marked for review.
- Crash/reconnect preserves pending obligations and cannot report them falsely complete.
